Commentary.Commentary: Luke Ronchi got them off to a flying start, but a flurry of wickets in the middle ensured New Zealand did not capitalize on their start. Jimmy Neesham's knock in the end helped them crawl to 189. It looks like it will be an easy chase for India but can New Zealand spring in a surprise? Join us shortly for the chase.

Mohammed Shami and Bhuvaneshwar Kumar were the pick of the bowlers, both bagging 3 wickets each. Both of the Indian spinners, Jadeja and Ashwin were given a short spell and they both were handy with the ball. For the Black Caps, it looked like nobody wanted to spend time in the middle.

India have done really well to restrict New Zealand to 189. New Zealand will not be happy with their batting effort as the pitch looks like a very good batting wicket. The Kiwis got off to a flying start with Luke Ronchi smashing the ball to all parts of the ground but India kept chipping away at the wickets at regular intervals.

OUT! That's the final nail in the coffin! Back of a length delivery on off, Boult clears his front leg and looks to slap it over covers. He is not in a good position and so he doesn't get enough elevation on it. Mohammed Shami who is stationed there stays composed and takes a good catch with his fingers pointing upwards. NEW ZEALAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 189!
Excellent effort, Karthik! On a length and angling into Boult. He picks it over square leg. Dinesh sprints across to his right and puts in a full length dive to save two runs for his side.
Neesham gives himself room and Kumar follows him. Tucked to mid-wicket for a run.
Tailing in from a fuller length into Neesham. He looks to tuck it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Shortish delivery on middle, Boult plays a forehand smash over mid off and does so with good effect. Gets a boundary to his name.
Off cutter around the pads, worked around the corner for a single.
Shortish delivery and it's angling in, Boult stays leg side of the ball and glides it uppishly to third man for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Boult flat-bats it towards mid off and fortunately for him, the ball lands in front of the fielder.
Hardik Pandya is back on.

FOUR! Smashed! Fuller length ball around off, Neesham hits it hard over the bowler and the ball races towards the long off fence. Umesh runs to his left and makes a casual effort to concede the boundary.
Wide! Attempts the slower delivery but sprays it down the leg side, left alone.
Dug in short, Neesham ducks under it.
Full length delivery angling into Boult. He is early into his clip and gets a safe leading edge towards mid off. A run taken.
Length delivery on middle, Boult defends it off his front foot.
The batsman plays the pull shot. They pick up a single.
Yorker around the pads, Jimmy keeps it out nicely.

In the air... but safe! A cutter on a good length outside off, Neesham clears his front leg and looks to go over covers. However, he is early into his shot and ends up miscuing it high in the cover-point region. Three fielders runs towards it but the ball falls in the no man's land. A run taken.
Full and tailing in nicely, Boult nudges it to fine leg for a run.
Fuller length ball in line of the stumps, Neesham has a wild heave at it and drags it through square leg for a single.
Cover-point goes back.
Full delivery on off, Neesham keeps it out to covers.

FOUR! Just clears the man at short third man! Slower delivery well outside off, Neesham throws his bat at it but gets an outside edge. The ball spoons towards third man and just about clears the leaping Dhawan for a boundary.
Fullish delivery around off, driven hard to extra cover.
Trent Boult is the last man in.

OUT! The Kiwis are falling down like a pack of cards! Length delivery outside off, shapes in a touch. Southee with minimal foot movement attempts to force it through covers. Gets a thick inside edge and the ball deflects back onto the stumps. Second wicket for Kumar.
Slower short delivery on middle, Neesham helps it towards backward square leg. Pandya sprints to his left and keeps it down to a single.
Wide! Kumar comes around the wicket and angles in a bouncer. Neesham ducks under it. Wide signaled for height.
Good length delivery around off, Southee runs it down to third man for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Tim mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
That's a peach! Good length delivery outside off, jags back appreciably. Southee doesn't have any clue about it and is tentative to get his bat down. Gets beaten all ends up.
Good length ball on middle, turned around the corner for an easy single.
Wide! Starts off with a loosener down the leg side, Neesham moves inside the line and lets it go.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns back for his second spell.
Dug in short on middle, Southee plays a well-controlled pull through backward square leg. Two runs taken.
Fullish in length this time, Neesham drills it to long on for a run.
Short of a length outside off, Southee places it towards point. Jadeja fumbles a touch and allows the single.
Full length ball on off, driven crisply to mid on.
Close shave! Length delivery around off, Southee comes forward tentatively and looks to keep it out. Misses and the ball goes past the gap between his bat and pad and just whizzes over his off stump.
Short delivery on leg stump, pulled with ease to fine leg for a single.
Searches for the yorker but bowls a low full toss, Southee keeps it out. A wicket and two runs from the over.
Tim Southee is the new man in.
Drinks taken.

OUT! Umesh gets his first wicket! He has bowled aggressively and gets the reward. Bowls a quick bouncer but it is going down leg, Milne looks to hook it but is hurried on by it a touch. Ends up getting a bit of glove on it. The ball flies towards MS Dhoni behind the stumps and he accepts the catch gleefully. India have impressed with the ball so far.
Fullish delivery on off, whipped past the diving Hardik Pandya at mid-wicket. Single taken.
Back of the hand slower bouncer outside off, Milne half pulls it towards front of square on the leg side for a run.
Fullish delivery outside off, moving away and inviting Milne for a drive. He accepts the invitation but gets foxed by it.
Length delivery outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Well bowled! An off cutter around off, Neesham goes for a booming drive but is beaten.
Fuller length ball in line of the stumps, the southpaw goes for a heave across the line but again gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full length ball on off, Jimmy looks to whip it through mid-wicket but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Neesham looks to dab the length delivery behind square on the off side but the room is not quite there. Ends up defending it.
Length delivery on off, Neesham camps back and blocks it.
Fuller length ball around off, Milne drives it towards mid off and takes off. It is a tight run but it is completed safely in the end as the shy at the bowler's end misses.
Mohammed Shami is back on. He is on a hat-trick.
Change of gloves for Adam Milne.
Keeps it on a back of a length around the hips, Milne looks to tuck it but gets it off the gloves to fine leg. A run taken.
Another sharp short delivery on middle, comes on quickly to Neesham who mistimes the pull through mid-wicket for a run.
Digs it short around the rib-cage area, Milne is hurried on by it and mistimes his pull through backward square leg for a single.
Length delivery on off, Adam shuffles a touch and defends it to mid on.
Low full toss on off, Neesham clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on off, Milne drives it down to long on for a single.
Plays it with the turn on the leg side for a single.
defends the ball on off stump, off the front foot.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Flighted ball, Neesham comes down the track and heaves it over square leg and races away to the fence. A much needed boundary for New Zealand.
On the pads, Neesham tickles it fine and they run two, had Dhoni collected the throw it would have been close.
Quicker ball, Neesham defends it off the back foot.
Another slower one outside off, cutting in. Milne comes forward and has a push at it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Yorker on off, Jimmy jams it out to sweeper cover for a run.
Sharp bouncer on leg stump, Neesham ducks under it to evade it.
Fuller length delivery well outside off, Neesham drives it to covers.
Yadav bowls the back of the hand of the delivery on middle, Milne reads it and clips it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
That's a jaffa! Bowls it on a good length outside off, leaves Milne after pitching. He pokes at it but is beaten comprehensively.
Flicks it to mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up, Milne flicks it to short mid-wicket.
Off spinner on a length, Milne defends it onto the ground.
Tosses the leg spinner up and Milne defends it off the front foot.
Comes down the track and hits it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Quicker ball, angling in, Neesham defends it off the back foot.
The physio comes out and straps Virat Kohli's knee.
Strays on the pads, Neesham flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Length ball, Milne opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
A well-directed bouncer, Milne ducks under it.
Length ball, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Length ball outside off, Milne cuts it to point.
YORKER! Umesh starts off with a perfect yorker. Milne does well to dig it out.
Umesh Yadav is called into the attack.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Same area, Same shot. Tosses it up again, Neesham heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! GOOD INTENT FROM NEESHAM! Floats it up and Neesham heaves it over short mid-wicket for a boundary.
Adam Milne comes out to bat.

OUT! NEEDLESS FROM SANTNER! Ashwin flights it up on off stump, Santner comes down the track and tries to loft it over the long on fence but is not near the pitch of the ball. Ends up mistiming it towards wide long on. Ravindra Jadeja runs to his left and takes it comfortably. Ashwin is having a good outing after coming back from injury.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Flatter ball, Santner pushes it to cover region.
Tosses it up, Neesham goes down on one knee and sweeps it to deep square for a run.
Quicker ball, batsman defends it off the back foot.
On the pads, Neesham flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Flatter ball, pushes it to mid-wicket.
Bowled on the pads, Santner works it on the leg side for a run.
Batsman pushes it to covers off the back foot.
Flatter ball, Santner defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! MUCH NEEDED ONE! Floats it on off stump, Neesham drags the ball from outside off stump to the mid-wicket boundary.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman
Played off the back foot to deep point for a run.
Floats it up, Neesham goes for a drive but gets an inside edge to short fine leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

CONFUSION! They do not want a run out at this moment. Tosses it up, Neesham clips it to mid-wicket. Santner wants a run but Neesham sends him back. There is a shy at the non-striker's end but does not hit and Santner makes his ground.
Drives it down to mid on for a run.
Flatter ball, Neesham defends it off the front foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Jimmy Neesham walks out to bat.

OUT! SIXTH WICKET! Quicker outside off by Jadeja as he sees the batsman coming down the wicket. De Grandhomme gets into an uncomfortable position but goes for the cut. Misses it completely and Dhoni is quick to take the bails off. Jadeja is weaving his magic at the Oval.
Full and is driven towards mid on.
The batsman, waits for the ball to turn and guides it to point region for a couple.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Quicker ball and Santner pulls it to mid on.
A leg spinner by Ashwin, pitches it short, the batsman rocks back and cuts it to deep point for a run.
Floats it up, Santner drives it long on for a run.
Short and spins the other way, the batsman cuts it off the back foot to deep point for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Santner goes back and pushes it through covers for a run.
Short outside off, the batsman cuts it to point.
Defends the ball on middle off the front foot.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
Colin de Grandhomme comes out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Jadeja gets the big wicket. Ronchi departs after playing a good innings. Short and fast on off stump, the ball skids through. Ronchi goes for the cut but misses and the ball hits the top of off. Jadeja gets his first. New Zealand lose half their side and are in a lot of trouble.
Tossed up, Ronchi drives it uppishly just short off Kohli at covers.
Flatter outside off, Ronchi cuts it to cover-point for a couple.
Santner gives himself room and Ashwin bowls it full and quick around his pads. Kept out in the end. Good start from Ashwin.
Flighted outside off, Ronchi plays it with an open face towards point. A run taken.
Fullish on off, eased through mid off for an easy single.
Ashwin sees Santner giving the charge and tosses it nicely on middle. He blocks it down the track.
Floated around off, Santner prods forward in defense.
A touch short on middle and leg, pulled behind square leg for a run.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes onto bowl.
Quicker one on middle and leg, Luke eases it to long on for a run and will retain the strike.
Flatter delivery on off, Ronchi eases it to covers.
Tossed up around off, pushed to covers.
Quicker one once again coming in with the arm, Ronchi looks to drive it through covers but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Coming in with the arm. Ronchi defends it nicely.
Flatter delivery around off, Ronchi taps it towards cover-point.
Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack. A slip is in place for Jadeja.
Shortish delivery on off, Santner mistimes his pull to deep square leg for a couple.
Back of a length outside off, Santner looks to place it square of the wicket but gets a bottom edge on it down the track.
Short and outside off, Santner doesn't fiddle with it.
Ronchi taps this one towards point and completes a sharp single.
Good comeeback from Pandya! Bowls a good length delivery on  off, shapes away after pitching. Ronchi looks to play it with an angled bat but gets beaten all ends up.

SIX! Good intent from Ronchi! He comes down the track and gives himself room to the good length delivery. Lifts it with authority over wide long off for a maximum. He is constructing his innings really well.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ronchi strokes it to sweeper cover for a run.
Wide! Bowls it pretty wide this time and Ronchi fails to reach it.
Straight on this occasion, Santner turns it towards wide mid on and sets off. Dhawan comes across and has a shy at the bowler's end but no harm done.
Bowls it short on leg stump, Santner ducks under it. One bouncer for the over signaled by the umpire.
A touch fuller on off, Santner puts his head down and defends it calmly.
Back of a length on off, Santner hangs back and answers it with a straight bat.
In the channel outside off, Mitchell lets it go.
Well bowled! Length delivery outside off, shaping away after landing. Ronchi reaches out for it, plays away from his body but gets beaten. Good over from Pandya.
On a good length on middle and leg, Santner works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery angling into Luke. He pulls it uppishly but safely down to fine leg. A couple taken.
Edged! Good length delivery leaving the southpaw. He is surprised by a bit of an extra bounce and gets an outside edge past first slip. A run taken.
Ronchi taps this length ball towards covers and sets off. Good judgement and he gets a run for it.
Straying on the pads, tucked through backward square leg for a single.
Short of a length outside off, tapped to point.
Kumar comes around the wicket and keeps it straight. Santner is a bit late in bringing his bat down but manages to get it around the corner. A run taken.
On a length on middle and leg, Santner stays back and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Mitchell Santner is the new man in.
Time for Drinks.

OUT! Kumar outfoxes Anderson and gets rewarded for his consistency. Bowls it on a good length in line of the stumps, Anderson charges down the track and goes for a wild slog across the line. Ends up getting a thick inside edge to see the stumps behind him rattled. Poor selection of shot from the southpaw and he pays the price for it.
Shrewd from Kumar! Sees Anderson chipping down the track and digs it in short, Anderson is out of position but goes through with his pull. Misses and the ball hits him on the arm.
On a fuller length around off, Anderson covers the line and defends it to short cover.
Dug in short around off, Ronchi arches back to evade it.
Straying on the hips, Anderson turns it towards wide mid on. Slight hesitation in the calling but the batsmen cross for the run in the end.
Fuller length ball around off, Corey strides forward and defends it towards mid off.
FOUR! Put away with ease! Shortish delivery on middle and off, Anderson picks up the length quickly and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Corey defends it solidly off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, placed through point for an easy single.
Hardik Pandya is back on.
FOUR! Straight as an arrow! Pitched in line of the stumps, Anderson shimmies down the track and thumps it over the bowler's head for a boundary. That was hit with brute force.
Length delivery on off, defended solidly off the back foot.
Kumar is hitting the right lines and lengths. Bowls it on a good length on off, shapes away after pitching. Anderson bails out of a stroke at the last moment to allow it through.
FOUR! Good shot! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Anderson creams it through covers for an exquisite boundary.
Fifty up for Luke Ronchi!

Fullish delivery and straight this time, Ronchi is early into his whip and gets a leading edge that flies towards third man. Single taken. It has been a good exhibition of strokeplay from the Kiwi opener.
Length delivery outside off, Ronchi looks to punch it but gets it from the toe-end towards the bowler.
On a length on off, Anderson is opened up a touch in his stance but defends it nicely in the end.
Length delivery outside off, Corey plants his front foot across and sees it through.
Good length delivery leaving the southpaw. He shuffles a touch, plays inside the line and lets it go.
Length delivery outside off, dabbed neatly to third man for a single.
Well-directed bouncer on off, Ronchi arches back, drops his wrists and allows it through. Bumrah is right on the money.

This is good bowling! Good length delivery outside off, hitting the seam and shaping in sharply. Ronchi is caught in the crease as he looks to tuck it across. Fails to get any bat on it and gets pinged on the pad.
On a fuller length on off, Anderson lunges forward in defense. Probing over from Kumar. It's a maiden!
Poor shot! On a similar length again, leaving the southpaw. Anderson flays his bat at it but only connects thin air.
Fuller length ball outside off, Corey goes for a booming drive but is beaten all ends up.

Well bowled! Good length delivery and appreciable away movement on that. Anderson feels for it and gets an outside edge that lands short of Rahane at second slip. Playing with soft hands saved him there.
Fullish delivery slanting across Anderson. He drives it with an open face to Jadeja at point.
On a length around off, Anderson stays back and defends it to covers.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl now.
Powerplay 2 signaled by the umpire.
LUCKY! Full on the pads, Ronchi goes to flick it but gets a leading edge over short mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
WIDE! Bowls a fast bouncer, but it bounces above the batsman's head and is called a wide.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length delivery, angling into the batsman, Ronchi clips it uppishly but in the gap between mid-wicket and mid on for a couple.
Tries to bowl a slower one, but ends up being a high full toss, Ronchi clips it through mid wicket for a couple.
Back of a length ball, defended off the back foot.
Corey Anderson is the new man in.

OUT! TWO IN TWO FOR SHAMI! Broom goes for a golden duck! Length ball outside off, Broom tries to guide it down to third man but gets an outside edge straight into the gloves of Dhoni who takes a simple catch. Shami will be on hat-trick on the first ball of the next over.
Neil Broom walks out to bat!

OUT! THE CAPTAIN FAILS TO MAKE AN IMPACT! Some respite for Shami here, gets the big wicket off Williamson. Back off a length ball on off stump, Williamson tries to push it on the off side off the back foot but gets an outside edge and is gobbled at a widish second slip by Rahane. Shami gets his second wicket.
Full on off, Ronchi drives it straight back past the bowler, who gets a hand to it and they run through for a run.
SIX! HUGE HIT! Back of a length ball, Ronchi stands tall and pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum. First one of the day. Fourteen off the first three balls.
FOUR! Second off the over. Full this time on off stump by Shami, Ronchi clears his front leg and lofts it over mid off for another boundary.
FOUR! POOR LINE AND PUNISHED! Shami drifts on the pads of Ronchi, who flicks it past short fine leg for a boundary. He is looking in good shape here.
Peach of a delivery! Pitched slightly ahead of length outside off, Williamson strides forward to defend but the ball nips back in and goes from the gap between the bat and the pad.

DROPPED! Back of a length delivery, angling in, Ronchi makes room and flat-bats it down the ground. Fails to make a clean connection and the ball goes towards Ashwin at mid on, who dives to his left, gets his left hand to it but fails to hold on to it. Maybe should have gone with two hands there. A run is taken off the drop!

BEATEN! Superb delivery from Bumrah! Pitched on a good length around off, Ronchi prods forward to defend with the angle but the ball straightens after pitching and whizzes past the outside edge of Ronchi's bat.
Ronchi makes room, Bumrah cleverly follows him, cramping the Kiwi for room. Ronchi only manages to defend it to mid on.
On a length and shaping in, clipped to mid-wicket.
Angling into the batsman, defended with the angle to mid on.
Length ball, Williamson defends it to mid-wicket.
Shami bowls it full, Ronchi moves his front leg away and goes for a heave but gets an inside edge to deep square leg for a run.
Moves away and lofts the length ball over covers, but doesn't time it well so they only get two.
Full on the pads, Ronchi clips it to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Ronchi gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! GREAT SHOT! Ronchi makes room for himself, Shami bowls it full and Ronchi drives it through covers for a boundary. Great intent shown from Ronchi.
Length outside off, Ronchi guides the ball down to third man for a run.
BEATEN AGAIN! Short and wider outside off, Ronchi again goes for the cut but does not connect.
BEATEN! Short outside off, gets some extra bounce, Ronchi slashes at it but gets beaten and the ball goes through to the keeper.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! GREAT SHOT! Slightly short and Ronchi cuts it past backward point and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Ronchi cuts it but gets a bottom edge straight to first slip.
Jasprit Bumrah comes into the attack.
Again bowls it on a length, Williamson plays it to the point region. Good over by Shami.
Williamson defends the length ball on off stump off the front foot.
A tad fuller on off, Williamson drives it straight to covers.
Lands it on a length, Williamson covers the line off the ball and defends it off the front foot.
Length ball, Williamson defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length ball, Ronchi plays it on the off side with soft hands and they get through for a run.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.

Three Wides! Way too short and it bounces way above the batsman's head, Dhoni can only get a hand to it and deflects it to fine leg. It's called wide for overhead bouncer and the batsmen run a couple of byes as well.
FOUR! LUCKY EDGE! Short and wide outside off, Williamson slashes at  it but gets an outside edge and the ball flies over the first slip for the second boundary off the over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Lands it on a length, Williamson tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten.
Wide! Strays down leg side and the umpire calls it a wide.

FOUR! NOT INTENTIONAL! A good ball by Pandya, on a length outside off, Williamson plays it with soft hands, gets it off the outer half in the gap between gully and first slip. Dhawan from first slip, dives to his right but fails to stop it and the ball races to the boundary. First boundary for Williamson.
Bowls it outside off, Ronchi cuts it to third man for a run.
Defends the length ball off the back foot onto the ground.
Lands it on a length on middle stump, Williamson pushes it to mid-wicket.
LUCKY! Shami lands it on a length on off stump, Ronchi tries to guide it down and gets an outside edge and it goes past the first slip down to third man for a run.
Back of a length ball, Ronchi pushes it to mid on.
New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson strides out to bat.

OUT! GONE! Big wicket for India! Guptill fails to play big. Length ball outside off, Guptill tries to loft it over mid off but it comes from the higher part on the bat and lobs to Bhuvaneshwar Kumar at mid off. Mohammed Shami provides the crucial breakthrough!
BEATEN! Lands on a length on off stump gets some shape away, Guptill pokes at it and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
FOUR! BACK-TO-BACK BOUNDARIES! Full ball on off, Ronchi belts the ball down past mid off for a boundary. Great start for New Zealand 20 off the first 2.
FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! Length ball on off stump, Ronchi stands tall and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bowls a length ball on the pads, Ronchi misses the flick and it hits him high on his thigh pad.
Back of a length ball, Ronchi defends it off the back foot.
Strays on the pads, Ronchi clips it behind square leg for a couple.
Hardik Pandya to bowl with the other new ball.

FOUR! THAT MADE A CRACKING SOUND OF THE BAT! Length ball, Guptill plants his front foot ahead and drives it beautifully through covers for the first boundary of the day. 10 off the first over by Shami.
Length ball, Ronchi tries to drive it on the up, gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length ball, Guptill pushes it off the back foot to cover-point for a run.
Length ball outside off, Guptill let's the ball go through to the keeper.
Drifts on the pads, Guptill tucks it behind square for another couple.
Starts of with a full ball angling into the pads, Guptill flicks behind square and Kedar Jadhav gives it a chase. He slides near the fence to keep it down to a couple.

We are set to get rolling. The umpires and the players are making their out in the middle. Luke Ronchi and Martin Guptill to open the batting for New Zealand. Mohammed Shami to take the first new ball for India. Two slips in place. Here we go...

India skipper, Virat Kohli says that this is different from the Indian T20 League. Adds that toss is not in their hands. Mentions that everybody has done well in the Indian T20 League and they are in good form. Informs that Yuvraj Singh is not playing due to illness and Rohit Sharma due to some commitments back home while rest of the 13 will get a go at some part of the game.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson says that that they are gonna have a bat. Feels that it is a good surface and it will remain the same throughout. Mentions that he has a lot of experience in losing tosses. Reckons that it is important to do well in whatever they do. Says that every team comes here with high expectations. Further adds that any team can come out on top on a given day. Announces that Latham, Taylor and McClenaghan are sitting out. Ends by saying that twelve guys will have a go at some stage today.
Toss - New Zealand win the toss and opt to bat.

The Black Caps on the other hand are fresh from a Tri-Series victory in Ireland. They have always been superb in the ICC tournaments and would look to go one step ahead this time by winning it. It's going to be a good test for both the sides as they search for their best XI, going into the Champions Trophy.

Hello and a warm welcome to the warm-up game for the Champions Trophy, 2017 between India and New Zealand at The Oval. India are the reigning champions and are looking a well-balanced side. Their batting always has been their strength but this time around their bowling looks formidable with a solid pace attack and the spin twins - Ashwin and Jadeja coming back into the side.
